fusions.name: Deadfall Slam
fusions.desc: You rear up on the staff and drop your full weight down it. It deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Ragged Stubs
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with a limb left rough with broken branch stubs. It deals 8 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Winter Lean
fusions.desc: You settle your weight on the staff. It restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulk Behind the Bough
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your armour rises by 6%.
